children: CANONSBURG, Pa. and FORT WORTH, Texas, Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- EQT Corporation ("EQT") (NYSE: EQT) and Range Resources Corporation ("Range") (NYSE: RRC) today announced that they have entered into a definitive merger agreement, under which EQT will acquire Range in an all-stock transaction to create America's leading natural gas company with a pro forma enterprise value over $50 billion. The combination brings together two of the highest-quality natural gas assets in North America, creating America's largest and only vertically integrated natural gas producer with leading inventory depth and low-cost structure. Combined with a fortress balance sheet and the largest natural gas marketing platform in the country, these differentiated attributes solidify EQT as the operator of choice in the next era of demand-led natural gas growth.
Transaction Creates America's Natural Gas Champion
Asset Scale: Combined company will have >9 Bcfe/d of net production and >30 years of inventory across nearly 3 million net acres in addition to >3,700 miles of critical midstream infrastructure
Strategic Positioning: Transaction positions EQT as the clear partner of choice for end users of natural gas, enhancing EQT's abilities to serve Appalachian demand growth

Cost Structure: Improves EQT's unlevered free cash flow breakeven(1) to less than $2 per MMBtu while increasing NGL diversification, ensuring robust free cash flow through all parts of the commodity cycle

Synergy Value: Expect $325 million of base annual synergies within two years across corporate, operations and commodities marketing, with a pathway to more than $600 million long-term from development and infrastructure optimization, improved margins from natural gas, LNG and NGL marketing efforts, and the ability to accelerate inventory development into contractual demand-led growth

Financial Profile: 100% stock transaction with a pro forma enterprise value of more than $50 billion; further strengthens EQT's balance sheet and is expected to provide BBB quality credit metrics at closing

Earnings Power: Cumulative free cash flow(1) projected to be ~$20 billion over the next five years at recent strip pricing, creating shareholder value beyond what either company could achieve standalone

A non-GAAP financial measure. See the Non-GAAP Disclosures section of this news release for the definition of, and other important information regarding, this non-GAAP financial measure. Unlevered free cash flow breakeven is defined as the average Henry Hub price needed to generate positive unlevered free cash flow.

EQT President and CEO Toby Z. Rice stated, "This transaction brings together two of the highest-quality, longest-duration asset bases in North America and creates a company uniquely positioned for the next era of natural gas. As the lowest-cost natural gas producer in the industry, supported by multiple decades of high-quality inventory, the combined company will offer exceptional resilience through commodity cycles while maintaining significant upside to strengthening natural gas fundamentals. Additionally, our expanded resource base solidifies EQT as the operator of choice for premium, long-term supply arrangements and provides unique growth optionality underpinned by contractual demand. We believe this combination creates a must-own energy company capable of generating durable, through-cycle free cash flow while compounding value for shareholders for decades to come."

"This combination of two highly successful operators with decades of inventory creates opportunities to build long-term value neither could fully realize independently," said Dennis L. Degner, President and CEO of Range. "Our Board of Directors unanimously determined that this transaction will enhance Range shareholders' ability to participate in a constructive long-term natural gas and NGL macro outlook. The combined company will be uniquely positioned to capitalize on increasing demand for natural gas and liquids both domestically and internationally, delivering superior returns for investors. I want to thank our employees, whose hard work, dedication and commitment have positioned us to enter this next chapter of value creation with EQT."
Transaction Details

Under the terms of the merger agreement, unanimously approved by the Board of Directors of both companies, EQT will acquire Range in an all-stock transaction. Each outstanding share of Range common stock will be exchanged for 0.987 shares of EQT common stock. As a result of the transaction, EQT's existing shareholders are expected to own approximately 73% of the combined company and Range's shareholders are expected to own approximately 27%.

The transaction is expected to close during the first quarter of 2027, subject to the receipt of required regulatory approvals and clearances, approval of the transaction by shareholders of both EQT and Range, and the satisfaction of other customary closing conditions. Upon the closing of the transaction, two representatives from Range, including Dennis Degner, will join EQT's Board of Directors. EQT's executive management team will lead the combined company with headquarters remaining in Canonsburg, Pennsylvania.
Advisors

Citi and RBC Capital Markets, LLC acted as financial advisors to EQT. Kirkland & Ellis LLP is serving as EQT's legal counsel on the transaction. Evercore acted as lead financial advisor, J.P. Morgan Securities LLC also advised Range. Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher LLP is serving as Range's legal counsel on the transaction.
Conference Call and Webcast Information

EQT and Range will hold a joint conference call to discuss the details of the transaction at 8:00 AM ET today, October 26, 2026, which will be broadcast live via webcast. The live audio webcast and accompanying presentation is available on EQT's investor relations website,
, under "Events & Presentations" and on Range's investor relations website,
, under "News & Events." A replay will be archived in the same locations after the conclusion of the live event.

As a result of the announced transaction, EQT and Range are canceling their previously scheduled Q3 2026 earnings conference calls on October 28, 2026. Both companies will issue their Q3 2026 earnings results, as previously announced, after the market close on October 27, 2026.

About EQT Corporation

EQT Corporation is a premier, vertically integrated American natural gas company with upstream and midstream operations focused in the Appalachian Basin. We are dedicated to responsibly developing our world-class asset base and being the operator of choice for our stakeholders. By leveraging a culture that prioritizes operational efficiency, technology and sustainability, we seek to continuously improve the way we produce environmentally responsible, reliable and low-cost energy. We have a longstanding commitment to the safety of our employees, contractors, and communities, and to the reduction of our overall environmental footprint. Our values are evident in the way we operate and in how we interact each day – trust, teamwork, heart, and evolution are at the center of all we do.

About Range Resources Corporation

Range Resources Corporation is a leading U.S. independent natural gas and NGL producer with operations focused in the Appalachian Basin. The company is headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas. More information about Range can be found at www.rangeresources.com.

Non-GAAP Disclosures
Adjusted Operating Cash Flow, Free Cash Flow and Unlevered Free Cash Flow

Adjusted operating cash flow is defined as net cash provided by operating activities less changes in other assets and liabilities. Free cash flow is defined as adjusted operating cash flow less accrual-based capital expenditures and capital contributions to equity method investments. Unlevered free cash flow is defined as free cash flow, less interest expense. EQT's management believes that these measures provide useful information to external users of EQT's consolidated financial statements, such as investors, industry analysts, lenders and ratings agencies, regarding EQT's liquidity, including EQT's ability to generate cash flow in excess of its capital requirements and return cash to shareholders. Adjusted operating cash flow, free cash flow and unlevered free cash flow should not be considered as alternatives to net cash provided by operating activities or any other measure of liquidity presented in accordance with GAAP.

EQT has not provided projected net cash provided by operating activities or a reconciliation of projected adjusted operating cash flow, free cash flow or unlevered free cash flow to projected net cash provided by operating activities, the most comparable financial measure calculated in accordance with GAAP. EQT is unable to project net cash provided by operating activities for any future period because this metric includes the impact of changes in operating assets and liabilities related to the timing of cash receipts and disbursements that may not relate to the period in which the operating activities occurred. EQT is unable to project these timing differences with any reasonable degree of accuracy without unreasonable efforts such as predicting the timing of its payments and its customers' payments, with accuracy to a specific day, months in advance. Furthermore, EQT does not provide guidance with respect to its average realized price, among other items, that impact reconciling items between net cash provided by operating activities and adjusted operating cash flow, free cash flow and unlevered free cash flow. Natural gas prices are volatile and out of EQT's control, and the timing of transactions and the income tax effects of future transactions and other items are difficult to accurately predict. Therefore, EQT is unable to provide projected net cash provided by operating activities, or the related reconciliation of projected adjusted operating cash flow, free cash flow or unlevered free cash flow to projected net cash provided by operating activities, without unreasonable effort.
